narrative: OMX30 faces a challenging open amid negative global correlation (-0.342%) and broad European weakness (DAX -0.45%, FTSE -0.64%). While the index maintains bull regime structure (+3.7% vs 200-MA), technical overbought conditions (Stochastic K/D 85.6/86.3) and weak ADX (3.8, bearish DI bias) signal mean reversion risk and low conviction. US election volatility and NASDAQ weakness (-1.07%) pressure momentum names. The only tailwind is slightly lower USD/SEK at 9.797, but this is insufficient to offset macro headwinds. Support at 3085 (lower Bollinger), resistance 3180 (50-MA), with yesterday's 3123 close as pivot.
morningBrief: OMX30 opens into headwinds: global correlation deeply negative, European peers bleeding (DAX, FTSE both red), and Stochastic overbought signals mean reversion risk. ADX weakness (3.8) strips conviction from the bull structure. Watch 3123 pivot; weakness targets 3085 lower Bollinger band. Strength meets 3180 (50-MA) but expect struggles given overbought RSI and macro backdrop. Banks benefit marginally from yield structure (10Y yield stable at 4.894%) but defensive rotation more likely today. Tech/growth names (Ericsson, Hexagon) track NASDAQ weakness. Avoid chasing rallies in overbought regime; wait for oversold signals (RSI <40) for long entries. US Jobless Claims (14:30 CET) could spike volatility intraday.
